notes.title: Update notes for 9 March
notes.content:
Added hotkey support!

You can now use hotkeys for:
[list]
[*] Hiding/showing all overlays (Ctrl+Shift+F2)
[*] Enabling/disabling editor mode (Ctrl+Shift+F3)
[/list]
The default key combinations can be changed in the settings.

notes.title: Update notes for 5 March 2022
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I received a lot of feedback about making Overlay Studio resizable, so now it is! If you see any UI elements acting weird at larger sizes, feel free to post a screenshot in the [url=https://discord.gg/GmXZ8RfQ4N]Discord[/url]!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Made the Overlay Studio UI resizable
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlay Studio UI didn't always startup with the correct size.
[/list]

notes.title: Overlay Studio Beta program
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904099/99ea05d808c3c1c6f60fb3d601d143f56cb506e1.png[/img]

[h1]The Overlay Studio beta is here! [/h1]

You can sign up by joining our discord (https://discord.gg/GmXZ8RfQ4N) and dropping a message in the 'beta-request' channel!

Once you're in, feel free to create your own overlays, upload them to the workshop, and just in general play around with all features.

All feedback (both positive & negative) is welcome and can be given via our discord :)

(Note: it can take up to 16 hours to receive your key after posting your message in discord)
